UPDATE /* LGVPAY00029.applyAllSeveranceAllowanceInMonth */ TB_PAY_SEVERANCE_ALLOWANCE t1 SET (t1.WORKING_YEARS, t1.FLAG_YN, t1.AVERAGE_SALARY, t1.PERIOD_FOR_CAL, t1.PAYMENT, t1.MATERNITY_1_DAY, t1.MATERNITY_2_DAY, t1.MATERNITY_3_DAY, t1.MATERNITY_4_DAY, t1.PROBATION_DAY, t1.TOTAL_DAY, t1.PAID_MONTH, t1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, t1.LAST_UPDATE_USER_ID, t1.CONFIRM_FLAG) = (SELECT working_years,
CASE WHEN (working_years < 1 OR (NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0)) = 0) THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS flag_yn , average_salary, CASE WHEN flag_yn = 'N' THEN '0' WHEN (NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0))/30 > 42 THEN '4 years' WHEN (NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0))/30 > 36 THEN '3.5 years' WHEN (NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0))/30 > 30 THEN '3 years' WHEN (NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0))/30 > 24 THEN '2.5 years' WHEN (NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0))/30 > 18 THEN '2 years' WHEN (NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0))/30 > 12 THEN '1.5 years' WHEN (NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0))/30 > 6 THEN '1 year' ELSE '6 months' END AS period_for_cal , ROUND(CASE WHEN flag_yn = 'N' THEN 0 WHEN period_for_cal = '4 years' THEN average_salary * 2 WHEN period_for_cal = '3.5 years' THEN average_salary * 1.75 WHEN period_for_cal = '3 years' THEN average_salary * 1.5 WHEN period_for_cal = '2.5 years' THEN average_salary * 1.25 WHEN period_for_cal = '2 years' THEN average_salary * 1 WHEN period_for_cal = '1.5 years' THEN average_salary * 0.75 WHEN period_for_cal = '1 year' THEN average_salary * 0.5 ELSE average_salary * 0.25 END,0) AS payment , maternity_1_day, maternity_2_day, maternity_3_day, maternity_4_day, probation_day, (NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0)) AS total_day, ROUND(((NVL(maternity_1_day,0) + NVL(maternity_2_day,0) + NVL(maternity_3_day,0) + NVL(maternity_4_day,0) + NVL(probation_day,0) + NVL(adjust_day,0)))/30,0) AS paid_month, sysdate, #{applicationUserId}, 'Y' FROM ( SELECT employee_no ,severance_allowance_id ,payment_yyyymm ,period_1st_from ,period_1st_to ,period_2nd_from ,period_2nd_to ,period_3rd_from ,period_3rd_to ,period_4th_from ,period_4th_to ,flag_yn ,salary_1st ,salary_2nd ,salary_3rd ,salary_4th ,salary_5th ,salary_6th ,period_for_cal ,payment ,leaving_reason ,note ,CASE WHEN ((NVL2(period_1st_from,1,0) + NVL2(period_1st_to,1,0) + NVL2(period_2nd_from,1,0) + NVL2(period_2nd_to,1,0) + NVL2(period_3rd_from,1,0) + NVL2(period_3rd_to,1,0) + NVL2(period_4th_from,1,0) + NVL2(period_4th_to,1,0))/2) != 0 THEN ((NVL2(period_1st_from,1,0) + NVL2(period_1st_to,1,0) + NVL2(period_2nd_from,1,0) + NVL2(period_2nd_to,1,0) + NVL2(period_3rd_from,1,0) + NVL2(period_3rd_to,1,0) + NVL2(period_4th_from,1,0) + NVL2(period_4th_to,1,0))/2) ELSE NULL END AS maternity_times ,ROUND((EM.DATE_RETIRE - EM.DATE_HIRE_SUBSIDIARY + 1) / 365, 3) AS working_years ,NVL(ROUND((NVL(salary_1st,0) + NVL(salary_2nd,0) + NVL(salary_3rd,0) + NVL(salary_4th,0) + NVL(salary_5th,0) + NVL(salary_6th,0))/ NULLIF((CASE WHEN salary_1st IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN salary_2nd IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN salary_3rd IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN salary_4th IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN salary_5th IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN salary_6th IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) , 0), 0), 0) AS average_salary ,CASE WHEN period_1st_from IS NOT NULL THEN period_1st_to - period_1st_from + 1 ELSE 0 END AS maternity_1_day ,CASE WHEN period_2nd_from IS NOT NULL THEN period_2nd_to - period_2nd_from + 1 ELSE 0 END AS maternity_2_day ,CASE WHEN period_3rd_from IS NOT NULL THEN period_3rd_to - period_3rd_from + 1 ELSE 0 END AS maternity_3_day ,CASE WHEN period_4th_from IS NOT NULL THEN period_4th_to - period_4th_from + 1 ELSE 0 END AS maternity_4_day ,CASE WHEN EM.PROBATION_START_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE EM.PROBATION_END_DATE - EM.PROBATION_START_DATE + 1 END AS probation_day ,adjust_day FROM TB_PAY_SEVERANCE_ALLOWANCE TS, EMP_MASTER EM WHERE TS.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} -- 급여대상자SetId AND TS.EMPLOYEE_NO = EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER ) sub where sub.severance_allowance_id = t1.severance_allowance_id ) WHERE t1.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} -- 급여대상자SetId
